about: Three known voices in cafe noise, two turns where two people talk at once, and one quiet voice.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Right, so who is coming to the working bee at the community garden on Sunday?

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: I can do the morning, but I have to leave by lunch for my nephew's party.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: I'm in for the whole day, as long as somebody brings a proper ladder for the shed roof.

over.speaker: Dave
over.text: I've got a ladder at home, it's a bit wobbly though.

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: Sorry, I was saying I can bring my ladder over in the car.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Great. Sam, could you sort out the gloves and the rubbish bags for everyone?

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Sure, I'll grab them from the hardware store on Saturday morning before it gets busy.

over.speaker: Alex
over.text: Get the heavy duty ones, the thin ones always tear.

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: And I'll bring a tin of biscuits, because nobody works properly without biscuits.
